fusions.name: Blood Lapping
fusions.desc: Sends out a pulse that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sip From the Cut
fusions.desc: A bite that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Blind Hunter
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Roving Ping
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 lightning damage. Once every 4 seconds.
